create_CacheConfig: create a CacheConfig instance with custom block_size, gpu_memory_utilization, and cache_dtype settings
build_CacheConfig_hash: build a computation graph hash from CacheConfig using compute_hash to identify config factors
test_CacheConfig_block_size: test CacheConfig applies default block_size of 16 when block_size is None
review_CacheConfig_cache_dtype: review CacheConfig cache_dtype validation that logs info for per-token-head and quantized types
summarize_CacheConfig_metrics: summarize CacheConfig metrics_info that converts all fields to a key-value string dict for prometheus
